acts.title: ACTS Translational Science 2027
acts.summaryWhat: FACT: ACTS has published TS27 for April 20–23, 2027 in Washington, DC. FACT: No host hotel or meeting venue is named on the Translational Science or Upcoming/Past Meetings pages. FACT: Recent cycles alternate cities (2026 Milwaukee; 2025 Washington, DC). HYPOTHESIS (labeled): Because the city is Washington and lodging is unpublished, downtown full-service hotels including Mayflower are in the competitive set once housing opens — this is not a confirmed room block.
acts.hotelOpportunityThesis: Mayflower (Connecticut Avenue Autograph, ~581 rooms, downtown meetings inventory) is a realistic candidate for association lodging if TS27 uses a downtown DC footprint. ACTS headquarters is listed at 2001 K Street NW — same downtown corridor as Mayflower (1127 Connecticut Avenue NW), which supports a downtown lodging conversation. Limitation: NIH/CTSA attendees who prefer Bethesda medical-campus lodging may divert demand to Montgomery County hotels; Mayflower’s play is downtown DC, not Bethesda overflow.
acts.fitExplanation: Qualitative fit: strong for downtown DC association lodging; weaker if the unnamed venue lands far from Connecticut Avenue or if planners prioritize Bethesda for NIH adjacency. No numeric score — reviewed package has no canonical fit engine run.
acts.whyNow: Dates and city are public while registration and housing are still forthcoming — the practical window to ask about lodging process is before a host hotel announcement. Do not treat as open demand until Elizabeth/ACTS confirms housing status.
acts.recommendedAction: Email Elizabeth Lancaster (Events Manager): confirm whether TS27 will use a downtown DC convention/hotel footprint or a medical-campus pattern; ask whether a housing list is open and whether Mayflower can be considered for primary, overflow, or preferred lodging.
acts.travelingCohort: CTSA / translational science researchers, trainees, and partners traveling to Translational Science 2027 (TS27). Official ACTS copy describes a multi-day annual meeting bringing the translational science community together — not a local staff-only session.
acts.destinationStatus: Washington, DC (city confirmed). Meeting venue and host hotel not named on official ACTS pages.
acts.competitiveContextNote: Venue and host hotel unknown. Competing downtown brands and Bethesda-corridor hotels may both be relevant depending on attendee mix. Peak rooms not published. Past DC years do not prove 2027 venue class.
acts.venueHistoryNote: Past ACTS Translational Science meetings often return to Washington, DC (e.g. 2025, 2023, and earlier DC years on the Upcoming/Past Meetings page) but also rotate (2026 Milwaukee; 2024 Las Vegas). Prior host hotels for TS were not captured in this package — ask ACTS rather than infer.
acts.hotelFitScoreNote: Qualitative hotel-fit assessment — no numeric score on this reviewed prospect.
